<span id="rules-of-thumb"></span>
== Rules of thumb ==

* A project’s own documentation lives in its repository; the wiki page is a summary that links back to the README.
* A decision goes in the [[Decision log]], not only in chat.
* If a page fits two sections, put it in one and link from the other.
* Keep working notes out of page text. Use the <code>TODO:</code> convention from the [[Style guide]].
